title: Globus ingress answers document
description:
Every value a human supplies for `pixi run globus login` and `pixi run globus doctor`, and nothing else. Contract 2.0: the Globus Connect Server host, its endpoint and `globus init` are retired (openspec retire-globus-host), and this document renders no Terraform input — the setup wizard owns every Terraform variable.

The rule this file exists to enforce is that the list stays SHORT. A value belongs here only when no machine can work it out: SSM names, secret names, the Kubernetes Secret and the 30-day session rule are all derived or fixed.

gate.title: Human gate identifiers
gate.description: The steps no automation can perform. A field's `x-gate` names the gate that produces its value, so a form can show what is being waited on instead of an empty box. Each is also the remedy kind `human` of the `doctor` check that finds it missing.

aws_account_id.title: AWS account ID
aws_account_id.description: The 12-digit account this deployment lives in. Used ONLY to verify that the credentials in your environment point at the account you meant: `login` refuses to run when they disagree. It is not a credential and grants nothing.

native_app_client_id.title: Globus native app client ID
native_app_client_id.description: The UUID of the native app registered in the Globus Developers Portal, which is the one registration no command can make: a native app is what a person logs in through, and a browser flow cannot be scripted. `globus login` uses it for the browser flow that produces the refresh tokens the pipeline lists and copies with. A native app has no secret.

source_collection_id.title: Source collection UUID
source_collection_id.description: The Globus collection data is copied FROM, over its HTTPS server. You are granted access to it by the data provider, so this value and your access to it both come from that agreement. `login` requests this collection's HTTPS scope.

source_base_path.title: Source base path
source_base_path.description: The path on the source collection under which subject directories live. A subject identifier is appended to it, so give the parent directory, not a subject.

identity_domain.title: Institution identity domain
identity_domain.description: The identity domain the source collection's High Assurance policy requires, for example your university's domain. `login` asks for a session in it. Use `identity_domains` instead if more than one applies.

identity_domains.title: Institution identity domains
identity_domains.description: Every identity domain the source's High Assurance policy accepts, when one is not enough. Supply this or `identity_domain`, not both.

deployment_name.title: Deployment name
deployment_name.description: A short lowercase name for this deployment, from which the SSM prefix (/<name>/globus/...) and the cluster's name are derived. Defaults to `cloudpipe`.

aws_region.title: AWS region
aws_region.description: The region this deployment's SSM parameters, secret and cluster live in, for example eu-west-1. Defaults to the AWS profile's region.
